answer: Work waits on the inlet until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the comet of the next round. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the beacon of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, diluted when peers disagree, each submission carries a fresh nonce.
